notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes: - Fixed Play button

notes.title: Update Notes for 23rd February 2025
notes.notes:
- You can now dash as soon as dashing is finished or you've cancelled your dash
 - Dash speed has been slightly increased when on the ground
 - Fixed Evasion Bug
 - Introduced Level Editor (VERY EARLY TEST - YOU CAN NOT SAVE LEVELS YOU HAVE MADE YET)
 - Added Slime mob to the first few levels
 - Added new music for Level Editor

notes.title: Update Notes for 25th August
notes.notes:
- Level 9 revamped
- Added Bronze and Silver blocks to the game

notes.title: Update Notes for 14th August
notes.notes:
Level 7 has been revamped.
Jump powerup now has particle effect.

notes.title: Update Notes for 9th August
notes.notes:
Level 6 has been revamped.
Wooden platforms added.
Clock sprite has been revamped for the speedrunner timer.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 7th
notes.notes:
You can now jump and dash by holding w or up arrow.
You can use the practice mode as a level selector.

Changes to collision detection to make gameplay smoother.
Can now dash on Mushroom Blocks.

notes.title: Update Notes for 4th July
notes.notes:
Level 5 revamped!
 - Spikey Balls have been added
 - Spikey Ball Spawners have been added
 
 - Some of Evasion's textures have had an upgrade
 - Reworked Bouncy Flowers so they launch you a set distance

notes.title: Update Notes for June 1st 2024
notes.notes:
Level 2 spikes now kill the player
Level 3 has been revamped

The first Hidden Level has been revamped

notes.title: Update Notes for 31st May 2024
notes.notes:
Gameplay
Added a background
Added dash ability when space or shift is pressed with left or right arrow keys
Ned shoots faster spikes

BlockJump is currently being revamped so the new Level 1 is available - other levels are still the old ones

Operating System Support
Mac & Linux is now compatible
